articles.title: Amazon Reveals Free Uber Eats Delivery for Prime Members, Plus $20 Off Your First Two Orders
articles.summary: Amazon Prime members can now get $0 delivery fees on orders over $25. Amazon revealed in a November 5 press release that this benefit is now available to use, and subscribers are eligible for $20 off their first two orders for the next two weeks.
body: This new service replaces the Prime GrubHub+ benefit, which has officially expired as of today. If you're already a member, all you need to do is search 'Uber Eats' on Amazon to find restaurants and start placing an order. Alternatively, you can go straight to the official Uber Eats page to check out what's available.

The press release doesn't explain why Amazon made the shift from GrubHub+ to Uber Eats, only that this will be the partnership moving forward. Amazon Prime Vice President Jamil Ghani commented how the deal fits into the service, saying: “This is what Prime is all about: unlimited free, fast delivery on a wide selection of products, big savings, fantastic entertainment, and now even more value on restaurant delivery with Uber Eats, all in a single membership.”

For those with an Amazon Prime membership already, this is basically free food money. You can use this promotion to get a discount on dinner for your family or go wild and order a stack of KFC Doomsday Chicken Sandwiches for yourself. The bonus $20 off credit will only last from now until November 19.
points: Amazon Prime members can now get $0 delivery fees on orders over $25.

articles.title: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves
articles.summary: Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie. The animated flick will be produced by the same team that produced the John Wick movies, comprised of Thunder Road’s Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee, 87Eleven…
body: Shannon Tindle, an Emmy Award-winning director, writer, and producer known for works like Ultraman: Rising and Kubo and the Two Strings is set to direct. Screenwriting duo Ryan and Kaz Firpo are onboard to write the film; the two are known for Marvel’s Eternals.

This is the latest news we’ve gotten from this highly-anticipated project after it was first announced last year. Adam Fogelson, motion picture chair at Lionsgate, gave fans a little something to chew on during its announcement, saying, “In both animation and the world of ‘John Wick,’ the possibilities are endless. And there is no ‘John Wick’ story fans are clamoring for more than the ‘Impossible Task.’ Shannon’s take on that story is an incredible one, and we are beyond excited to see what John Wick can do in animation.”

The specific animation house responsible for bringing John Wick’s action-packed, assassin-filled world to life has not yet been officially announced. For now, it’s anyone’s guess as to what it will eventually look like, but it’s certainly exciting news while we wait for John Wick 5.

articles.title: EA Killed Mass Effect But Is Still Trying To Make Money On It
articles.summary: Electronic Arts recently killed off Mass Effect and closed developer BioWare entirely, but the publisher is still trying to make money from the franchise's fanbase. Ahead of the annual Mass Effect holiday of N7 Day on November 7, EA is promoting Mass Effect via posts about what fans can buy on the…
body: The BioWare Gear Store's social media presence came back to life after a month of darkness today to start hawking Mass Effect merch. The post that kicked things off is the one below, in which fans are invited to "celebrate the legacy" of Mass Effect by giving EA money.
EA followed the post up with eight more, pushing people to visit the BioWare Gear Store to buy things like mugs, tote bags, clothing, and shoes, among other things.
The replies under every one of the posts call out how cold and gross it is to promote the brand so soon after cancelling Mass Effect 5 and closing BioWare.

EA made the drastic changes as part of a big organizational shift and wider pullback that also included layoffs and other game cancellations, like a new The Sims game. These moves came after EA was taken private by an investor consortium led by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund in a deal that included billions of debt.

articles.title: Spectrum Is Offering Free Internet Upgrades So People Can Download GTA 6 Faster
articles.summary: Spectrum customers can get a free internet upgrade this month to download GTA 6 faster. The company announced earlier this week that it would be a free "Gig Speed Lift" from November 9 to November 30 for existing customers.
body: Pre-loading for GTA 6 begins on November 10, and it will be an absolute beast of a game when it comes to download size. Rockstar has confirmed that the game is 212 GBs, which is nearly a quarter the size of the average PS5 (not counting the required space for the OS and other mandatory elements on the console). Given that fans are anticipating a pretty massive open-world with lots to see and do, the size makes sense. As a result, fans will want to take full advantage of the nine-day pre-load window or hop on this Spectrum deal so they can play as soon as possible.

We're officially just two weeks away from the GTA 6's launch. Rockstar released 39 new screenshots from the game earlier today, showing off Vice City, Jason and Lucia in action, and a whole bunch of crime. The screenshots also revealed that rapper Kodak Black would be in the game as an NPC, which has fueled speculation that other musical artists would be in the game. The likes of Dr Dre, Phil Collins, and others have all been prominently featured in-game in other GTA titles, so it's not a stretch to imagine some celebrities in a modern-day Vice City.

articles.title: Bill Skarsgård Explains Why Starring in Hideo Kojima’s Physint Is a ‘Big Deal’ for Him
articles.summary: In September 2026, Hollywood’s resident horror icon Bill Skarsgård was confirmed to play the lead role in Hideo Kojima’s highly anticipated action-espionage project Physint. This game marks a long-awaited return to form from Kojima as fans pine for another Metal Gear-style experience.
body: Skarsgård opened up about the game in a November 5 episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he revealed that he’s a massive fan of the Metal Gear series and shared a conversation he had with Kojima regarding his love for cinema.

“That’s a big deal for me,” he said. “Specifically, the Metal Gear Solid games. I played every single [one], at least the ones on [console] platform. Starting from the one on PlayStation 1 all the way to the last one. I was very enamored by [Kojima], the mythology and the universes he creates, but also the sort of mystique and allure about him, as well.

Skarsgård went on to confirm that he is providing performance capture for the game, something he already has experience with thanks to his role in Marvel’s Eternals and his extensive past working with mocap studio Goodbye Kansas (known for Alan Wake 2, God of War, Cyberpunk 2077 and many more).

articles.title: Switch 2 Won’t Get Another Price Hike, At Least Not Soon, Nintendo Says
articles.summary: As part of Nintendo's latest earnings briefing, the company said it has no plans to increase the Switch 2 price again, or at least not anytime soon. VGC reported that management said Nintendo has enough memory stockpiled to shield itself and thus not need to implement another price hike.
body: Nintendo raised the price of the Switch 2 in September, bringing it up from $450 to $500. This followed price hikes for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles, meaning that all three major platforms have seen hikes.

The price increases are the result of macroeconomic factors including tariffs and the demand for memory and components from AI companies. Following the US midterm elections, technology stocks--and specifically AI stocks--have massively sold off, at least temporarily. It remains to be seen when or if there would be any relief on the memory and component market, though.

Nintendo also reported in its earnings briefing that it received many millions in tariff refunds, but the company is keeping all of it for themselves, just like PlayStation and other companies are doing with their own refunds. Nintendo had a tone-deaf and cringey tariff sale.
Nintendo's latest big game release was The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's remake for Switch 2, and it's the best-reviewed game of 2026 overall.

articles.title: Classic Halo Trilogy Gets Brand-New Release on Nov. 10
articles.summary: It's been a busy year for Halo fans, with plenty of new releases and surprises keeping the franchise alive. Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the original game, is bringing Master Chief's first adventure to a new generation, while a tabletop adaptation is also in development.
body: Now, fans looking for even more Halo content have another release to look forward to this holiday season. A new book collection bringing together three classic novels from the franchise is on the way, giving longtime fans and newcomers a chance to revisit some of Master Chief's most important adventures.

Titled Halo: The Master Chief Omnibus, the hardcover collection arrives on Nov. 10, from Gallery Books. It brings together three bestselling novels by authors Eric Nylund and William C. Dietz, alongside a new foreword and additional material.
The new omnibus collects three novels that helped establish the Halo universe's expanded lore: The Fall of Reach and First Strike by Eric Nylund, and The Flood by William C. Dietz.

Originally published as stand-alone books, the novels explore different stages of humanity's war against the Covenant, the alien religious empire threatening humanity's survival. They also provide additional context for Master Chief, the Spartan super-soldier better known as John-117, and the events surrounding the original Halo trilogy.

Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the original game, is bringing Master Chief's first adventure to a new generation, while a tabletop adaptation is also in development.

articles.title: GTA 6 Looks Pretty Realistic, Until It Comes To Gym Etiquette
articles.summary: Compared to previous games in the series, Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it'll only be a few steps removed from reality when it launches this month. Actions have consequences, working on a relationship requires more than just hitting a few button prompts, and bulking up means that you'll have to…
body: While I keep telling myself that comparison is the thief of joy and that I shouldn't compare the few strands of muscle fiber I have next to a digital character who looks like he curls Jack Reacher actors for a morning routine, I also can't help but find myself repulsed by Jason's lack of hygiene.

I'm also told that Miami--the city that GTA 6's location of Vice City is inspired by--is hot as hell, but that's still no excuse to not be wearing any gym clothing up top. Hell, even if it's one of those gym tank tops with spaghetti straps, that's still better than nothing, because I cannot imagine how much disinfectant you'd need to clean up that rack when Jason is done with it.

There's no sign of a sweat towel either, so you just know there's going to be a rank puddle of perspiration waiting for the next unlucky person who uses it. Revolting. Maybe it's his home gym, but that's still no excuse to work out in this state. Sure, maybe he's the only person who uses that facility, but I bet you the nearby NPCs are going to smell it from across the block.

articles.title: How to find Richard the dog in Ocarina of Time
articles.summary: Finding Richard is a side quest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You might have seen Richard, the adorable dog, during your first visit to Hyrule Castle Town: a white energetic dog that you couldn’t pet because its owner would accuse you of trying to steal her dog.
body: Luckily, you can help the distressed owner to find her precious dog. Below, we explain how to find Richard in the Ocarina of Time remake.

To find Richard, you must visit Hyrule Castle Town during the night and identify it among the running dogs. To know which one is Ricard, you must look for a white dog that will twirl and emit a high-pitched bark when you interact with it. All the other dogs have a deeper bark and briefly stand on their hind legs instead of spinning like Richard does. Since you can only look for Richard at night, consider unlocking the Sun's Song to change the time.

While it is possible to find Richard through trial and error, you don't need to. First look for the white dogs, then interact with them to see how they react. Since there aren't many white dogs, checking each one does not take much time. When I found Richard, he was on the street on the left side of the map, but I can't guarantee that it would always be in the same place for every player.
points: Finding Richard is a side quest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

articles.title: Xbox enters the 'faster PC launcher' arms race, its app loads faster now too
articles.summary: Xbox has joined the 'faster launcher load times' arms race, announcing that its updated Xbox PC app, available now to Xbox Insiders, launches up to 60% faster, and has also been overhauled to offer "simpler navigation, updated filters, and new ways to organize your games." Along with the faster…
body: Along with the faster launch time, Xbox said the home, store, and Game Pass pages in the updated app load up to 50% faster, while in-app windows open up to 65% faster—depending upon factors including device, internet connection, system configuration, and usage, of course. Library navigation has been simplified, search has been improved, and friends and social features are now part of the main navigational window.

Credit where it's due: That change to friends and social features is welcome. I don't use the Xbox App much—to be blunt, it's pretty much exclusively for Sea of Thieves. But after a long stretch away from it, I recently jumped back in for some high seas adventures with the crew, and I'll tell you this: Figuring out how to connect with my fellow online swashbucklers was kind of a headache compared to the super-simplicity of Steam. It worked fine, it just wasn't smooth and easy, so anything that helps with that, I'm happy to take.

articles.title: Warren Spector sounds even angrier about BioWare's closure as he recounts the massive salaries of EA execs: 'Is there ANY accountability left in this world?'
articles.summary: Two weeks after literally calling "bullshit" on EA's decision to close BioWare, immsim legend Warren Spector has posted a follow-up message on LinkedIn that avoids the spicy language but sounds angrier than ever. "I recently posted my thoughts about EA’s shuttering of BioWare," Spector wrote.
body: "The tragedy of so many layoffs the last few years hasn’t been lost on me, but for some reason, BioWare hit me on an emotional level nothing before had. I was gut-punched."

But some readers, he continued, replied to say that BioWare's best days were behind it, and that shutting it down was a "sound business decision." Those reactions appear to have re-stoked Spector's rage, as he said those people missed his actual complaint: That the game industry executives who are responsible for these problems are never the ones to suffer the consequences.

"If studio-level people leave, resulting in dilution of talent, someone is creating an environment that pushes them out. Do those culture-killers pay any price?" Spector wrote in his new message. "If executives misread the market, over-hire, or make decisions that result in under-funded, over-funded, poorly-marketed games, do they lose sleep, let alone jobs? Do those same executives suffer like developers when the needs of financial partners and investors take precedence over players, does anyone up there care?

articles.title: Nintendo says it isn't planning any more Switch 2 price hikes
articles.summary: Nintendo, which unveiled the results of the first half of its fiscal year 2027 earlier today, has now said it has access to enough quantities of memory to manufacture more Switch 2 consoles.
body: As a result, the platform holder does not plan to increase the price of the Switch 2. That's according to Reuters, citing Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa.

Nintendo, which has so far sold 26m Switch 2 consoles, has already raised the price of the console earlier this year. The price hikes, which took effect on 1st September in the US, Canada, Japan and Europe, saw the console's price increase by $50 / €30 / ¥10,000. Although that was technically the first price hike for the console itself, prior to the Switch 2's launch last year, Nintendo raised the price of Switch 2 accessories in the US as a result of the Trump Administration's tariffs.
The reason that would cause Nintendo to raise prices again is the same that already caused rival PlayStation and Xbox to do so: AI-driven, global memory and storage shortages.

PlayStation already raised PS5 and PS5 Pro prices, on several occasions. Xbox has likewise gone through multiple rounds of price hikes for its Series X and Series S consoles, with the most recent having taken place in August.
points: Nintendo, which unveiled the results of the first half of its fiscal year 2027 earlier today, has now said it has access to enough quantities of memory to manufacture more Switch 2 consoles.
